newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.

LIVE CATTLE - steady to 0.10 cent higher - Product values were higher on Thursday and from a technical standpoint the market looks bullish. Some concern, however, emerging that the futures premium to cash may be widening too far and futures may be close to peaking.

FEEDER CATTLE - steady to 0.10 cent up - Modest overnight losses in CBOT corn may be supportive early. The latest CME feeder cattle index, for July 23, was up $0.18 at $82.17, its highest level since March 17, 1994.

LEAN HOGS - 0.10 to 0.15 cent lower - Product prices continue to weaken and cash hogs seen steady to off $0.50 per cwt Friday. There also appears to be some concern that Thursday's run-up was overdone.

PORK BELLIES - 0.20 to 0.50 cent higher - There could be some follow-through buying after Thursday's limit advance. There has, however, been little confirmation of rumored Japanese buying interest in bellies or loins.
